research_question: Does the exact FactorData calendar assignment and formula implementation reproduce the seven failed GKX quarterly characteristics on a later confirmation decade?

frozen_calendar_rules.quarterly: date_trunc(month, datadate) + (lag_quarter + 3) months - 1 day with lag_quarter=4; represented by the month six months after datadate month
frozen_calendar_rules.annual: date_trunc(month, datadate) + (lag_annual + 2) months - 1 day with lag_annual=6; represented by the month seven months after datadate month

frozen_formula_rules.cinvest: current PPE investment rate minus mean of the prior three rates
frozen_formula_rules.nincr: length up to eight of the consecutive quarter-over-quarter ibq increase streak
frozen_formula_rules.roeq: ibq/lag1(scal), using the source code's quarterly book-equity fallback
frozen_formula_rules.ms: exact six annual and two quarterly source-code indicators, including its published m8 comparison of roavol with the industry sgrvol median

pass_rule: Each feature passes separately using the unchanged V015 threshold. A failed feature remains unavailable for the 2022-2025 bridge.
stopping_rule: Do not change the six-month quarterly or seven-month annual calendar assignment after confirmation. Further corrections require a new version and new source evidence.
